items.content_html: PatchMe is a lightweight system version monitoring tool that centralizes system states, software versions, and compliance, enabling early detection of vulnerabilities. Built on Zero Trust principles, it exposes only one secure API endpoint, with all systems reporting exclusively to it—eliminating direct logins and reducing the attack surface.

items.content_html: This repository implements a full-stack movie recommendation system that uses semantic text embeddings to compute movie similarity. Text embeddings are generated with Hugging Face’s all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model (lightweight, fast, high-quality for semantic search), enabling efficient similarity search and recommendations in the Node.js backend.

items.content_html: yt-data-extractor is a lightweight Node.js + Express application that uses the YouTube Data API v3 to fetch channel information and filter short-form videos. It provides two API endpoints: /shorts — Retrieves recent YouTube Shorts from a specified channel. /channel-info — Fetches detailed channel metadata, including statistics, and thumbnails.
